reuse.why: The link guard is one shared prepareBankAccountForLink used by every provider and unlinkAccount's clearing is extracted and reused, but the Fintegra provider copies linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions are near-verbatim copies of the Akahu functions (only provider name, server key and sync source differ).

placement.why: Link rules sit in accounts/app.ts, the download in accounts/sync.ts, the URL in server-config and the type in types/models, matching where each provider's pieces already live.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; the client edits are only the type-required provider entries.

maintainability.why: The link guard is well centralised, but every fix to the provider link/download flow must now be made in one more copied function.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountForLink gains only the requested replaceExistingLink flag (and the closed-account check as part of its single rule); all six provider link functions call it
